column1: # Python control suites deliberately NOT run by `scripts/run-python-controls.py`.
# Format: <suite name><TAB><reason>.  A missing reason is a hard error, and so is
# an entry naming a file that no longer exists -- this list fails in BOTH
# directions, the same shape `scripts/check-shape-duplicates.py` uses for
# duplicate declarations and `scripts/check-absence-claims.py` for absence
# claims.  It replaces an unexplained numeric floor of 188.
# Adding a line here is a decision that someone can read and argue with.  That
# is the entire point: `PY_ORPHAN_BASELINE=188` was a number nobody chose,
# accumulated one lane at a time, and it made 49% of this repository's Python
# controls permanently invisible.
# EVERY LINE BELOW IS A LIABILITY, NOT A SETTLEMENT.  These 19 suites were
# measured on 2026-08-27 (commit a00924af0) and each one is either unrunnable by
# the gate's invocation form or RED TODAY.  Nothing here is "fine" -- it is
# named so it can be fixed.
# (a) pytest dialect, and `pytest` is not installed on this fleet.
# `import pytest` -> ModuleNotFoundError under `python3 -m unittest`, so these
# six cannot run under ANY gate in this repository: no caller invokes pytest and
# the module is absent.  They use pytest only for `pytest.raises(E, match=...)`,
# which is `self.assertRaisesRegex(E, ...)` in the dialect every other suite
# here uses -- so the fix is a mechanical rewrite, not a redesign.  Not done in
# this lane: converting a suite is a change to what it ASSERTS, and these six
# guard capture/census producers owned elsewhere.
test_capture_maestro_device_id
